newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas up in June, other bid/offer spreads wide.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas up in June, other bid/offer spreads wide.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw only 25 lots traded on Wednesday morning in two separate deals, both in June which is now the front month after May rolled on Tuesday.
Both deals showed a rise on the previous settlement, with the last trade done at 10.65 pence a therm, up by 0.135 pence from the settlement level.

In all other months, a wide bid/offer spread was in place by the midday close of the morning session. Bids and offers straddled the previous settlement level, giving no indication of potential market direction. But the OTC market has been strong in the last few days, especially in the winter quarters.
